query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.partnerType,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE customerId = p.id) as vendas,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchaseOrders WHERE supplierId = p.id) as compras
FROM partners p
WHERE p.name LIKE '%teste%' OR p.name LIKE '%Teste%' OR p.name LIKE '%TESTE%' OR p.name LIKE '%test%';
